ma.getScreenBrightness(Object object)

Obtain the screen brightness.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)
object.success Callback Function
Parameter
Object object
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getScreenBrightness:ok
value Number Screen brightness. The value ranges from 0 to 1, where 0 indicates darkest and 1 indicates brightest.

Sample Code

ma.getScreenBrightness({
  success: (res) => {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail (err) {
    console.error(err);
  },
  complete () {
    console.log('getScreenBrightness:complete');
  }
});
